LightningComponentBundle.description: 3D viewer for glTF and GLB models using the JS library Three.js

property.name: modelUrl
property.label: Model URL
property.description: URL of a glTF or GLB model, e.g. of a static resource: /resource/carModel. Without it, the viewer shows a crate.

property.name: height
property.label: Height
property.description: Height of the viewer, e.g. 400px. The width follows the container.

property.name: backgroundColor
property.label: Background Color
property.description: Background color of the scene as a CSS color, e.g. #f3f3f3 or white. Without it, the background is black.

property.name: enableControls
property.label: Enable Controls
property.description: Rotate the model with the mouse or touch, zoom with the wheel and move it with the right mouse button.

property.name: disableRotation
property.label: Disable Rotation
property.description: Stop the model from rotating on its own.

property.name: showCard
property.label: Show Lightning Card
property.description: If present, the viewer is wrapped in a lightning card to fit better into the overall page layout.

property.name: cardIcon
property.label: Card Icon
property.description: If show card option is active, the card icon is displayed in the header before the card title. It should contain the SLDS name of the icon. Specify the name in the format 'utility:down' where 'utility' is the category and 'down' the icon to be displayed.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: If show card option is active, the card title can include text and is displayed in the header above the viewer.
